children: President Trump reiterated that he thinks interest rates are too high, but stopped short of publicly calling on Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh not to raise them.
"I have a lot of respect for him and he'll do what he has to do," Trump told reporters in the Oval Office when asked about the possibility that the Fed will raise rates.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).

title: Trump on Prospect of Warsh Supporting Rate Hikes: 'He'll Do What He Has to Do' — WSJ
